title: RetainedGeometrySourceVertexIndex
description: Sparse u32 source point ordinals map to mesh-local vertex indices in one item generation. Original u64 entity IDs remain in the captured graph/source index.
$comment: Three fixed 256-way metadata levels and 512 paired-u32 entries per payload page allocate only touched paths, one original-funded page per turn. Generation changes invalidate mappings logically while all backing remains owned until granted close.
